welcome.smallModelTipsSub: Using a small model ? Keep prompts short and specific. Use web search for facts, code execution for math. For complex tasks, consider switching to a larger model if possible.

voice.error.micUnavailable: No microphone was found. Connect a microphone and click the mic again.

settings.ai.models.saveError: Could not save — reload and try again
settings.ai.providers.connectError: Invalid key — check it and try again

settings.ai.providers.noOther: Groq is the only cloud provider available for now

sandbox.title: Sandbox
setup.welcome.title: Welcome to RealOpen-AI
setup.welcome.subtitle: Your fully offline, private AI assistant. This setup wizard will help you configure your hardware profile, choose which features to enable, and download the required AI models.
setup.welcome.offline: Everything runs locally on your machine — no data is sent to the cloud. All models are downloaded from Ollama and run entirely offline.
setup.prerequisites.title: Prerequisites Check
setup.prerequisites.subtitle: Let's make sure everything you need is ready.
setup.hardware.title: Hardware Detection
setup.hardware.subtitle: We detected the following hardware on your system.
setup.modules.title: Choose Modules
setup.modules.subtitle: Enable the features you want. Required modules are always active. Optional modules can be toggled later in Settings.
setup.review.title: Review Configuration
setup.review.subtitle: Confirm your setup before we download the models.
setup.installing.title: Downloading Models
setup.installing.subtitle: We're downloading the AI models needed for your configuration. This may take a while depending on your internet speed.
setup.installing.retryHint: Check your connection and run the setup again to retry
setup.done.title: Setup Complete!
setup.done.subtitle: Your RealOpen-AI is ready. All models have been downloaded and your configuration has been applied. You can start chatting now!
brain.title: Brain
brain.memories.empty: No memories yet. They will be automatically extracted from your conversations.
brain.skills.description: Learned skills from your conversations will appear here
brain.documents.description: Uploaded documents and knowledge base will appear here
brain.history.info: Search through all your past conversation messages by keyword. The AI can also search these automatically when you ask about something discussed previously.
brain.tools.description: Configure the tools your AI can use. Disabling a tool removes it completely from the model's capabilities; tag-gated tools are only offered when the conversation mentions one of their tags.
brain.tools.enabledHelp: A disabled tool is completely unavailable to the model — it never appears in the tool list or gets executed.
brain.tools.alwaysLoadHelp: When on, the tool is offered to the model on every turn. When off, it is only offered when one of its tags matches.
brain.tools.modelHelp: The model that runs this tool's work. Default:
brain.tools.noCustomYet: This tool has no specific settings yet — only the general configuration above. Custom settings will arrive in future updates.
brain.tools.websearch.searxngSubtitle: Self-hosted metasearch — your default search backend
brain.tools.websearch.arxivSubtitle: Scientific preprints (arxiv.org) — searched by subject + keywords
brain.tools.websearch.googleSubtitle: Programmable Search Engine (needs API key + CSE id)
brain.tools.websearch.apiKeyHelp: Verified with a quick request to Google, then saved locally — never shown again.
brain.tools.tagsHelp: Activation tags — when Always load is off, the tool is offered only if the message mentions one of these tags (e.g. weather, news).
brain.tools.websearch.subject: Subject
brain.tools.imagegen.ollamaSubtitle: Local image models via the Ollama API (x/flux2-klein…)
brain.tools.imagegen.baseUrlHelp: Ollama server (empty = the global Ollama URL)
